description.en:
Removes a lineup lock set with CMND_BTL_SET_POS_LOCK. It takes out the first lock on that player whose scope covers the given scope, whatever its lock type. It does the same as SET_POS_LOCK(false, charaId, anyType, scope).
With the default scope (2), only locks that apply always (set with scope 2 or more, the SET_POS_LOCK default) are matched; a lock set with scope 0 or 1 needs that same scope here.
No shipped script calls it; they use SET_POS_LOCK(false, ...) or CMND_BTL_RESET_POS_LOCK.
Parameter ID of the locked player.
Scope of the lock to remove: 0, 1, or 2 and more (see CMND_BTL_SET_POS_LOCK).
Always null (also when no argument is given).

examples.case: Freeing a player locked on the bench (not found in script_clean/; invented)
